entries.proposition: THZ1 kills patient-derived high-grade glioma lines with an IC50 under 100 nM on all eleven lines in a 7-day viability assay, in a caspase-redundant manner.
entries.snippet: THZ1 potently killed primary HGG cells, with an IC50<100 nM on all cell lines tested
entries.anchor: Results / THZ1 is highly effective at killing primary HGG

entries.proposition: The text says normal fibroblasts and marrow stromal cells died after 7 days but not 3 days of THZ1.
entries.snippet: When THZ1 was administered to normal immortalized BJ fibroblasts and HS5 bone marrow stromal cells, cell death occurred after 7 days of incubation but not 3 days
entries.anchor: Results / THZ1 is highly effective at killing primary HGG

entries.proposition: Supplementary Fig 1c-e (200 dpi page render): normal BJ fibroblasts fall to about 10 percent viability by about 70-100 nM at 7 days (IC50 about 30-50 nM) and HS5 cells to about 0 percent by 100 nM; at 3 days BJ viability falls to about 55-65 percent from about 30 nM, so the 3-day curve is a partial loss, not no loss. The normal-cell 7-day IC50 lies in the same range as the glioma-line IC50 under 100 nM, so no selectivity window for normal cells is shown.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] BJ 3 d: ~100 to ~55-65 percent; BJ 7 d: ~100 to ~10, IC50 ~30-50 nM; HS5 7 d: to ~0 by 100 nM

entries.proposition: Mice with intracranial glioma xenografts given THZ1 showed no gain in survival over 40 days; from this the authors infer that THZ1 is not crossing the blood-brain barrier.
entries.snippet: indicating that THZ1 is not crossing the blood–brain barrier and cannot target CDK7 as a naked agent.

entries.proposition: Supplementary Fig 9 (200 dpi page render): Kaplan-Meier curves for vehicle and THZ1 10 mg/kg every second day for two weeks overlap, with steps of about 17 percent (about six mice per arm) and all mice dead by about day 32; no drug concentration in brain or tumour is shown, so the blood-brain-barrier conclusion is an inference from an absent survival effect, not a measured exposure.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation — pixels cannot be quote-matched] vehicle and THZ1 (10 mg/kg) curves overlap; last death ~day 32; steps ~17 percent

entries.proposition: The Methods paragraph on the intracranial experiment, read in full, states no dose, interval or group size and ends with the ethics statement quoted; it points to an earlier schedule by citation, and the dose appears only in the supplementary figure caption.
entries.snippet: This study was in accordance with the Australian Code of Practice for the Care and Use of Animals for Scientific Purposes (2004).

entries.proposition: The Discussion repeats that THZ1 in its current format was unable to cross the blood-brain barrier and that structural optimisation or conjugate delivery would be needed.
entries.snippet: In its current format, THZ1 was unable to cross the blood–brain barrier and provide effective antitumor therapy.
